description: Diagnostic to verify that the three weak signals (permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety) have their v3/v4 enrichments properly wired into the signal pipeline. Must: (1) query mcp_signal_enrichments for signal_type IN ('permission_scope', 'temporal_stability', 'tool_description_safety'), (2) COUNT DISTINCT scores per signal_type, (3) assert each has >=20 distinct score values (per enrichment contract), (4) report which enricher versions (v3/v4) are producing rows. Does NOT write to DB. Pure diagnostic — no rebuild directive unless wiring gap is confirmed. Service name: enrichment_wiring_diagnostic, port: none (CLI script).
